Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 36 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Ajay - 39 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Kavya - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Rohan: "Today feels like a good day."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Rohan: "Exactly right."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Rohan: "Mom, look at this."

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Sonali: "Rohan, look at this."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Rohan (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Rohan stands on the road. Sonali and Ajay stand near him.]

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Rohan sits in the back seat.]

Rohan (happily): "Exactly right."

[Rohan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Rohan (softly): "That was fun!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Rohan in the back.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Sonali, Ajay and Kavya stand near him.]

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Ajay: "Okay, Rohan."

[Rohan irons his school shirt.]

Sonali: "I knew it!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Rohan stands by the road. Sonali and Ajay stand near him.]

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan gets into the car.]

Rohan: "Okay, Dad."

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
